## Summary
A home paternity test provides an efficient way for individuals to explore biological relationships in the comfort of their own space. Typically designed as a non-legal DNA collection kit, this test compares the DNA of a child with that of an alleged father by allowing for at-home sample collection. The steps are straightforward: you collect samples using swabs or other materials provided in the kit and send them back to a laboratory for analysis.
